local DataHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("DataHelper"))

local UIResBar = script.Parent

-- 钻石
local gem = UIResBar.gem
local t_gem = gem.t_gem
gem.GroupTransparency = 1

-- 糖果
local candy = UIResBar.candy
local t_candy = candy.t_candy
candy.GroupTransparency = 1

-- 羽毛
local turkey = UIResBar.turkey
local t_turkey = turkey.t_turkey
turkey.GroupTransparency = 1

-- 姜糖
local gingerBread = UIResBar.gingerBread
local t_gingerBread = gingerBread.t_gingerBread
gingerBread.GroupTransparency = 1

while not DataHelper:IsInit() do
	task.wait(0.1)
end

function onGemChanged()
	local num = DataHelper:GetItem(nil,CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem)
	t_gem.Text = tostring(num)

end

function onCandyChanged()
	local num = DataHelper:GetItem(nil,CommonEnum.ItemId.Candy)
	t_candy.Text = tostring(num)
end

function onTurkeyChanged()
	local num = DataHelper:GetItem(nil,CommonEnum.ItemId.Turkey)
	t_turkey.Text = tostring(num)
end

function onGingerBreadChanged()
	local num = DataHelper:GetItem(nil,CommonEnum.ItemId.GingerBread)
	t_gingerBread.Text = tostring(num)
end

onGemChanged()
onCandyChanged()
onTurkeyChanged()
onGingerBreadChanged()
DataHelper.onItemChanged.Event:Connect(function(_,itemId:number) 
	if itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem then
		onGemChanged()
	elseif itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.Candy then
		onCandyChanged()
	elseif itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.Turkey then
		onTurkeyChanged()
	elseif itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.GingerBread then
		onGingerBreadChanged()
	end
end)
"},{"id":556,"text":"script.Parent.Enabled = false
--获取服务
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))
local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local TimeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.TimeValue
local gameController = GameHelper:GetController()
local v_isDaytime:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gameController,TimeValue.isDaytime)
local v_day:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gameController,TimeValue.day)

local DebrisService = game:GetService('Debris')
--客户端获取玩家
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
	2, -- Time
	Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, -- EasingStyle
	Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -- EasingDirection
	0, -- RepeatCount (小于零时 tween 会无限循环)
	false, -- Reverses (tween 完成目标后会反转)
	0 -- DelayTime
)
local tweenInfoFast = TweenInfo.new(
	1, -- Time
	Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, -- EasingStyle
	Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -- EasingDirection
	0, -- RepeatCount (小于零时 tween 会无限循环)
	false, -- Reverses (tween 完成目标后会反转)

)
local point = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting').PrimaryPart.CFrame

local tweenInfo2 = TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,0)
local tweenInfo3 = TweenInfo.new(0.1,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,20,true,0)

local UIResBar = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("UIResBar")
local UIInterface= player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("UIInterface")
local UIBagpack= player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("UIBagpack")

local ui = script.Parent:WaitForChild('mubu')
local dark = TweenService:Create(ui, tweenInfoFast, {BackgroundTransparency=0})
local blight = TweenService:Create(ui, tweenInfo, {BackgroundTransparency=1})

local up = script.Parent:WaitForChild("FrameUp")
local down = script.Parent:WaitForChild('FrameDown')

local FirstCowBoyCamera = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('FirstCowBoyCamera')
local CowBoyAttackCamera = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('CowBoyAttackCamera')

local Cams99 = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('Cams99')
local trainCam = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('trainCam')
local christmasCam = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('christmasCam')

local christmasCar = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('christmasCar')
local christmasCarStartPoint = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('christmasCarStartPoint')

local isSkip = false
local oldCowboyFilmEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("PlayCam"):WaitForChild("OldCowboyCemeteryEvent")
local oldCowboyFilmFinishedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("PlayCam"):WaitForChild("OldCowboyCemeteryFinishedEvent")
local oldCowboyFilmActive = false
local oldCowboyFilmSerial = 0

local function restoreOldCowboyView()
	workspace:WaitForChild("CamSetting"):PivotTo(point)
	local currentCharacter = player.Character
	local currentHumanoid = currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if currentHumanoid then
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
	end
	UIResBar.Enabled = true
	UIInterface.Enabled = true
	UIBagpack.Enabled = true
	script.Parent.Enabled = false
	script.Parent:WaitForChild("Language").Text = ""
	up.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	down.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end

local function finishOldCowboyFilm()
	if not oldCowboyFilmActive then
		return
	end
	oldCowboyFilmActive = false
	oldCowboyFilmSerial += 1
	oldCowboyFilmFinishedEvent:FireServer()
end

script.Parent:WaitForChild('SkipBtn').Activated:Connect(function()
	isSkip = true
	AudioHelper:StopExclusive("christmas_drop")
	local wasOldCowboyFilm = oldCowboyFilmActive
	restoreOldCowboyView()
	if wasOldCowboyFilm then
		finishOldCowboyFilm()
	end
end)

function showFilmUi(forceShow)
	
	if not forceShow and not GameHelper:IsNormalMode() then
		isSkip = true
		return
	end
	
	script.Parent.Enabled = true
	UIResBar.Enabled = false
	UIInterface.Enabled = false
	UIBagpack.Enabled = false
	
	script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text =''
	isSkip = false
	
end

function hideFilmUi()
	
	if isSkip then
		return
	end
	
	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()
		workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):PivotTo(point)
		
		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text =''
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
		blight:Play()
		blight.Completed:Once(function()
			if isSkip then
				return
			end
			script.Parent.Enabled = false
			UIResBar.Enabled = true
			UIInterface.Enabled = true
			UIBagpack.Enabled = true
		end)
	end)
end

local isEnd = false
local isPlayAttack = false
v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function()
	
	if v_day.Value  == 1 and v_isDaytime.Value == false then
		FirstMeet() --第一天夜晚
	elseif v_day.Value  == 2 and v_isDaytime.Value  == false then
		local v_christmasEvent = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("玩法开关"):FindFirstChild("圣诞节")
		--圣诞
		if v_christmasEvent.Value then
			ChristmasDrop()
		end
	elseif v_day.Value == 3 and v_isDaytime.Value == false then
		
		if  GameHelper:getCurMode() == CommonEnum.Mode.SleeplessNight then
			FirstMoonDay()
		end
		
		isSkip = true
		
	elseif v_day.Value  == 4 and v_isDaytime.Value  == false then
		
		FirstOutlawsFunc() --被察觉
	elseif v_day.Value  >= 99 and v_isDaytime.Value  == true and isEnd == false then
		Day99Func() --生存99夜
		isEnd = true
	end
	
	local flag = GameHelper:IsCanAttackCampfire()
	
	if flag and not isPlayAttack and not v_isDaytime.Value then
		CowBoyAttack()
		isPlayAttack = true
	end
	
end)


function FirstMeet()
	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = SheepCam:WaitForChild('Attachment').WorldCFrame
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		blight:Play()
		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = 'Something is watching at you in the darkness...'
	end)

	task.wait(8)
	hideFilmUi()
end

function FirstMoonDay()
	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()
		
		
		
		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = moonCam:WaitForChild('Attachment').WorldCFrame
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		blight:Play()
		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = 'The full moon has risen, and the dangers lurking in the night begin to stir.'
	end)

	task.wait(8)
	hideFilmUi()
end

function Day99Func()
	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0

		task.wait(3)
		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = "More game content and stories will continue in future updates."
	end)

	task.wait(8)

end

function FirstOutlawsFunc()
	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0

		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = 'Your camp has been exposed...'
		task.wait(3)

	end)

	task.wait(8)

end

function CowBoyAttack()
	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end

		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0

		blight:Play()

	end)

	task.wait(4)
	hideFilmUi()
	
end


function UnlockCave(cam,sound,Door)
	showFilmUi()

	local highLight = Instance.new('Highlight')
	highLight.Parent = Door
	highLight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	highLight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(182, 111, 40)
	highLight.FillTransparency = 0
	Debris:AddItem(highLight,6)

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0

		--sound:Play()

		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = cam

		blight:Play()
		script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = "The seal to the cave's depths has been lifted"
	end)

	task.wait(5)
	hideFilmUi()
end

ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('Events'):WaitForChild('PlayCam'):WaitForChild('CaveUnlockEvent').OnClientEvent:Once(UnlockCave)

end
ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('Events'):WaitForChild('PlayCam'):WaitForChild('TrainStartEvent').OnClientEvent:Once(TrainStart)

--圣诞

local carDropTweenInfo =TweenInfo.new(
	9,-- Time
	Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,-- EasingStyle
	Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -- EasingDirection
	0, -- RepeatCount (小于零时 tween 会无限循环)
	false, -- Reverses (tween 完成目标后会反转)
	0 -- DelayTime
)

local tempCar = christmasCar:Clone()
tempCar.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting')

local AskForFireEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('Events'):WaitForChild('PlayCam'):WaitForChild('AskForFireEvent')
local BLAST_RADIUS = 8 -- Blast radius of the explosion
local BLAST_DAMAGE = 60 -- Amount of damage done to players
local BLAST_FORCE = 2000 -- Amount of force applied to parts

local function OnExplosionHit(hitPart, hitDistance, blastCenter)
	if hitPart and hitDistance then

		if hitPart.Name ~= 'Handle' then
			hitPart:BreakJoints()
			local fire = Instance.new('Fire')
			fire.Parent = hitPart
			local blastForce = Instance.new('BodyForce', hitPart) --NOTE: We will multiply by mass so bigger parts get blasted more
			blastForce.Force = (hitPart.Position - blastCenter).unit * BLAST_FORCE * hitPart:GetMass()
			DebrisService:AddItem(blastForce, 0.1)
		end

	end
end

local npc1 = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('CowboyGunV2')
local npc2 = workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):WaitForChild('CowboyGunV4')

local prayTrack1:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc1, 97040859028602)
prayTrack1.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack1.Looped = false
local prayTrack2:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc2, 97040859028602)
prayTrack2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack2.Looped = false

local prayTrack3:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc1, 128753403579493)
prayTrack3.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack3.Looped = false
local prayTrack4:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc2, 128753403579493)
prayTrack4.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack4.Looped = false

local prayTrack5:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc1, 128777393337772)
prayTrack5.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack5.Looped = false
local prayTrack6:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc2, 93057550259608)
prayTrack6.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
prayTrack6.Looped = false

--128753403579493
--93057550259608
--128777393337772
function ChristmasDrop()

	showFilmUi()

	dark:Play()
	dark.Completed:Once(function ()

		if isSkip then
			return
		end
		
		AudioHelper:PlayExclusive("Christmas Tree", "christmas_drop")
		--整个移动到玩家位置
		workspace:WaitForChild('CamSetting'):PivotTo(character:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart').CFrame)
		
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		
		prayTrack1:Play()
		prayTrack2:Play()

		tempCar.Highlight.Enabled = true
		tempCar:PivotTo(christmasCarStartPoint.Attachment.WorldCFrame)
		
		local DROP = TweenService:Create(tempCar.PrimaryPart, carDropTweenInfo, {CFrame = christmasCarDropPoint:WaitForChild('Attachment').WorldCFrame})
		DROP:Play()
		
		task.delay(5,function() --爆炸
			--发送消息马车爆炸
			AudioHelper:PauseExclusive("christmas_drop")
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect("Boom", nil, {FallbackPosition = tempCar.PrimaryPart.Position, SourceKey = "christmas_blast"})
			
			for k,v in ipairs(tempCar:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA('BasePart') then
					v.Anchored = false
					v:BreakJoints()
					local fire = Instance.new('Fire')
					fire.Heat = 50
					fire.Parent = v
					local blastForce = Instance.new('BodyForce', v) --NOTE: We will multiply by mass so bigger parts get blasted more
					blastForce.Force = (v.Position - tempCar.PrimaryPart.Position).unit * BLAST_FORCE * v:GetMass()
					DebrisService:AddItem(blastForce, 0.1)
				end
			end
			
			--TODO 跳起来！
			prayTrack3:Play()
			prayTrack4:Play()
			--看后面，然后你看我我看你
			prayTrack1:Stop()
			prayTrack2:Stop()
			wait(2)
			prayTrack5:Play()
			prayTrack6:Play()
		
			script.Parent:WaitForChild('Language').Text = "Something just down from the sky——check it out!"
			
		end)

		-- Christmas music is managed by AudioHelper:PlayExclusive.
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = christmasCam:WaitForChild('Attachment').WorldCFrame
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		blight:Play()
		
	end)

	task.wait(13)
	hideFilmUi()
	AudioHelper:StopExclusive("christmas_drop")
	wait(3)
	tempCar:Destroy()
end

local function playOldCowboyCemeteryFilm(cam1Source, cam2Source)
	if oldCowboyFilmActive then
		return
	end
	local cam1CFrame
	local cam2CFrame
	if typeof(cam1Source) == "CFrame" and typeof(cam2Source) == "CFrame" then
		cam1CFrame = cam1Source
		cam2CFrame = cam2Source
	elseif typeof(cam1Source) == "Instance" then
		local cam1 = cam1Source:FindFirstChild("cam1")
		local cam2 = cam1Source:FindFirstChild("cam2")
		cam1CFrame = cam1 and cam1:IsA("Attachment") and cam1.WorldCFrame or nil
		cam2CFrame = cam2 and cam2:IsA("Attachment") and cam2.WorldCFrame or nil
	end
	if not cam1CFrame or not cam2CFrame then
		oldCowboyFilmFinishedEvent:FireServer()
		return
	end

	oldCowboyFilmActive = true
	oldCowboyFilmSerial += 1
	local serial = oldCowboyFilmSerial

	task.spawn(function()
		showFilmUi(true)
		if isSkip or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			finishOldCowboyFilm()
			return
		end

		dark:Play()
		dark.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.CFrame = cam1CFrame
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		script.Parent:WaitForChild("Language").Text = "The old cowboy stopped at the edge of the cemetery."

		blight:Play()
		blight.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		local cameraTween = TweenService:Create(
			camera,
			TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{CFrame = cam2CFrame}
		)
		cameraTween:Play()
		cameraTween.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		script.Parent:WaitForChild("Language").Text = "For a long while, he said nothing."
		task.wait(2)
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		hideFilmUi()
		task.wait(3.2)
		if oldCowboyFilmActive and serial == oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			restoreOldCowboyView()
			finishOldCowboyFilm()
		end
	end)
end

oldCowboyFilmEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(playOldCowboyCemeteryFilm)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if oldCowboyFilmActive then
		isSkip = true
		restoreOldCowboyView()
		finishOldCowboyFilm()
	end
end)



"},{"id":557,"text":"local textLabel = script.Parent -- Make sure this script is inside the UI container
local screenGui = script:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui") -- Reference to the ScreenGui
local referenceResolution = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) -- Reference screen size
local referenceTextSize = 30 -- Desired TextSize at the reference resolution 

local function updateTextSize()
	local currentSize = screenGui.AbsoluteSize -- Get the current screen size
	local scaleFactor = math.min(currentSize.X / referenceResolution.X, currentSize.Y / referenceResolution.Y) -- Uniform scaling factor
	local newTextSize = math.max(9, referenceTextSize * scaleFactor) -- Ensure TextSize doesn't go below 9
	textLabel.TextSize = newTextSize
end 


-- Update whenever the screen size changes
screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(updateTextSize) 

-- Run once at the start
updateTextSize()"},{"id":558,"text":"local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local DataHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("DataHelper"))
local CharaterSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterSetting"))
local CharaterUpgradeSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterUpgradeSetting"))
local CharaterStatsSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterStatsSetting"))
local DailyQuestsSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("DailyQuestsSetting"))

local screenGui = script.Parent
local rootFrame: Frame = screenGui:WaitForChild("RootFrame")
local closeButton: GuiButton = rootFrame:WaitForChild("btn_close")
local itemsFrame = rootFrame:WaitForChild("Items")
local scrollingFrame = itemsFrame:WaitForChild("ScrollingFrame")
local myItem = scrollingFrame:WaitForChild("MyItem")
local characterQuestGroup = myItem:WaitForChild("CharaterQuest")
local dailyQuestGroup = myItem:WaitForChild("DailyQuest")

local uiInterface = screenGui.Parent:WaitForChild("UIInterface")
local openButton: GuiButton = uiInterface:WaitForChild("UILeftFrame"):WaitForChild("btn_QuestList")

local dailyClassOrder = {
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.strategy,
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.survival,
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.craft,
}

local function isMobileLayout(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and (not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled or viewport.X <= 1400 or viewport.Y <= 900)
end

local function getTaskRowHeight(): number
	return isMobileLayout() and 34 or 44
end

local function applyTaskRowSize(item: GuiObject)
	item.Size = UDim2.new(item.Size.X.Scale, item.Size.X.Offset, 0, getTaskRowHeight())
end

local function setSubtitle(group: Instance, text: string)
	local subtitle = group:FindFirstChild("t_subtitle")
	if subtitle and subtitle:IsA("TextLabel") then
		subtitle.Text = text
	end
end

local function normalizeGroup(group: Instance)
	local keptPrefab: Frame? = nil
	for _, child in ipairs(group:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "TaskPrefab" then
			if not keptPrefab then
				keptPrefab = child
			else
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	if keptPrefab then
		keptPrefab.Visible = false
		applyTaskRowSize(keptPrefab)
	end

	return keptPrefab
end

local characterTaskPrefab = normalizeGroup(characterQuestGroup)
local dailyTaskPrefab = normalizeGroup(dailyQuestGroup)

local function getOrCreateTaskItem(group: Instance, prefab: Frame?, index: number): Frame?
	if not prefab then
		return nil
	end

	local item = group:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
	if item and item:IsA("Frame") then
		applyTaskRowSize(item)
		return item
	end

	item = prefab:Clone()
	item.Name = tostring(index)
	item.LayoutOrder = index
	applyTaskRowSize(item)
	item.Parent = group
	return item
end

local function hideTaskItems(group: Instance, fromIndex: number)
	for _, child in ipairs(group:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and tonumber(child.Name) then
			local index = tonumber(child.Name)
			if index and index >= fromIndex then
				child.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setTaskItem(group: Instance, prefab: Frame?, index: number, descText: string, curValue: number, targetValue: number, completed: boolean)
	local item = getOrCreateTaskItem(group, prefab, index)
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local desc = item:FindFirstChild("t_desc")
	local value = item:FindFirstChild("t_value")
	local tick = item:FindFirstChild("img_tick")

	item.Visible = true
	if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
		desc.Text = descText
	end
	if tick and tick:IsA("GuiObject") then
		tick.Visible = completed
	end
	if value and value:IsA("TextLabel") then
		value.Visible = not completed
		value.Text = string.format("%d/%d", curValue, targetValue)
	end
end

local function getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, level: number)
	if not characterLo or level >= 3 then
		return nil
	end

	local upgradeLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterUpgradeSetting, characterLo.missionId)
	if not upgradeLo then
		return nil
	end

	local questStr = level == 1 and upgradeLo.Level2Quest or upgradeLo.Level3Quest
	if not questStr then
		return nil
	end

	return CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(questStr)
end

local function renderCharacterTasks()
	if not DataHelper:IsInit() then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "Loading...")
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 1)
		return
	end

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local characterId = playerVo and playerVo.characterId
	if not characterId then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "No Character Equipped")
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "No Character Equipped", 0, 0, false)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(nil, characterId)
	local characterLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterSetting, characterId)
	if not characterVo or not characterLo then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "No Character Equipped")
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "No Character Equipped", 0, 0, false)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	if characterVo.lv >= 3 then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "Lv.3 Max Level")
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "Max Level", 1, 1, true)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, string.format("Lv.%d -> Lv.%d", characterVo.lv, characterVo.lv + 1))

	local quest = getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, characterVo.lv)
	if not quest then
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "No Character Quest", 0, 0, false)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	local index = 0
	for statsName, targetValue in pairs(quest) do
		index += 1
		local statsLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterStatsSetting, statsName)
		local curValue = tonumber(DataHelper:GetCharacterStats(nil, characterVo.id, statsName)) or 0
		local safeTarget = math.max(tonumber(targetValue) or 0, 0)
		local completed = safeTarget <= 0 or curValue >= safeTarget
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, index, statsLo and statsLo.desc or tostring(statsName), curValue, safeTarget, completed)
	end

	hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, index + 1)
end

local function renderDailyTasks()
	if not DataHelper:IsInit() then
		setSubtitle(dailyQuestGroup, "Loading...")
		hideTaskItems(dailyQuestGroup, 1)
		return
	end

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local records = playerVo and playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords
	local completedCount = 0

	for index, className in ipairs(dailyClassOrder) do
		local dailyQuestVo = records and records[className]
		local descText = string.format("%s: No Quest", tostring(className))
		local curValue = 0
		local targetValue = 0
		local completed = false

		if dailyQuestVo and dailyQuestVo.questId then
			local lo = ConfigHelper:GetById(DailyQuestsSetting, dailyQuestVo.questId)
			if lo then
				curValue = tonumber(dailyQuestVo.progress) or 0
				targetValue = math.max(tonumber(lo.times) or 0, 0)
				completed = targetValue <= 0 or curValue >= targetValue
				descText = lo.desc or tostring(dailyQuestVo.questId)
			else
				descText = string.format("%s: Invalid Quest", tostring(className))
			end
		end

		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end
		setTaskItem(dailyQuestGroup, dailyTaskPrefab, index, descText, curValue, targetValue, completed)
	end

	setSubtitle(dailyQuestGroup, string.format("Completed %d/%d", completedCount, #dailyClassOrder))
	hideTaskItems(dailyQuestGroup, #dailyClassOrder + 1)
end

local function refresh()
	renderCharacterTasks()
	renderDailyTasks()
end

local function openQuest()
	refresh()
	rootFrame.Visible = true
end

local function closeQuest()
	rootFrame.Visible = false
end

openButton.Activated:Connect(openQuest)
closeButton.Activated:Connect(closeQuest)

DataHelper.onInitPlayerVo.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onCharacterIdChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onCharacterVoChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)

closeQuest()
refresh()

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local IMMERSIVE_SCREEN_NAMES = {"UIMap", "UICraftItem", "UIBusiness", "UICraftBullet"}

-- 检测关闭复活功能
while true do
    task.wait(0.1)
    local suc = pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ResetButtonCallback",false)
    end)
    if suc then
        break
    end
end

local function getPlayerControls()
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local playerModule = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
    if not playerModule or not playerModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end

    local ok, playerModuleResult = pcall(require, playerModule)
    if not ok or type(playerModuleResult) ~= "table" or type(playerModuleResult.GetControls) ~= "function" then return nil end

    local controlsOk, controls = pcall(function()
        return playerModuleResult:GetControls()
    end)
    if not controlsOk then return nil end

    return controls
end

local function restoreDefaultTouchControls()
    if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then return end

    local playerGui:PlayerGui? = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local controls = getPlayerControls()
    if not playerGui or not controls then return end

    GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled = true
    pcall(function()
        controls:Enable()
    end)

    local touchGui = rawget(controls, "touchGui")
    local touchControlFrame = rawget(controls, "touchControlFrame")
    local touchGuiCount = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "TouchGui" and child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            touchGuiCount += 1
        end
    end

    local missingContainer = typeof(touchGui) ~= "Instance" or touchGui.Parent ~= playerGui or typeof(touchControlFrame) ~= "Instance" or touchControlFrame.Parent ~= touchGui
    if missingContainer and type(controls.CreateTouchGuiContainer) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            controls:CreateTouchGuiContainer()
        end)
        touchGui = rawget(controls, "touchGui")
        touchControlFrame = rawget(controls, "touchControlFrame")
    end

    if typeof(touchGui) == "Instance" and touchGui.Parent == playerGui then
        for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "TouchGui" and child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child ~= touchGui then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local activeController = rawget(controls, "activeController") or rawget(controls, "activeControlModule")
    local touchJumpController = rawget(controls, "touchJumpController")
    local thumbstickFrame = type(activeController) == "table" and rawget(activeController, "thumbstickFrame") or nil
    local jumpButton = type(touchJumpController) == "table" and rawget(touchJumpController, "jumpButton") or nil
    local thumbstickInvalid = typeof(thumbstickFrame) == "Instance" and thumbstickFrame.Parent ~= touchControlFrame
    local jumpButtonInvalid = typeof(jumpButton) == "Instance" and jumpButton.Parent ~= touchControlFrame
    local touchWasLocked = type(activeController) == "table" and rawget(activeController, "moveTouchLockedIn") == true
    local shouldResetController = missingContainer or touchGuiCount ~= 1 or thumbstickInvalid or jumpButtonInvalid or touchWasLocked

    if shouldResetController and typeof(touchControlFrame) == "Instance" then
        if typeof(touchGui) == "Instance" and touchGui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            touchGui.Enabled = true
        end
        if typeof(touchControlFrame) == "Instance" and touchControlFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then
            touchControlFrame.Visible = true
        end

        if type(activeController) == "table" and type(activeController.Enable) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                activeController:Enable(false)
            end)
            if thumbstickInvalid then
                activeController.thumbstickFrame = nil
                activeController.startImage = nil
                activeController.endImage = nil
                activeController.middleImages = {}
                activeController.middleImageFadeTweens = {}
                activeController.startImageFadeTween = nil
                activeController.endImageFadeTween = nil
            end
            activeController.moveTouchLockedIn = false
            activeController.moveTouchFirstChanged = false
            activeController.moveTouchStartPosition = nil
            activeController.moveVector = Vector3.zero
            activeController.isJumping = false
            pcall(function()
                activeController:Enable(true, touchControlFrame)
            end)
        end

        if type(touchJumpController) == "table" and type(touchJumpController.Enable) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                touchJumpController:Enable(false)
            end)
            if jumpButtonInvalid then
                touchJumpController.jumpButton = nil
            end
            touchJumpController.parentUIFrame = touchControlFrame
            touchJumpController.isJumping = false
            pcall(function()
                touchJumpController:Enable(true, touchControlFrame)
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            controls:Enable()
        end)
    end
end

local function restoreMobileControls(resetCharacterState:boolean?)
    local playerGui:PlayerGui? = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
        for _,screenName in ipairs(IMMERSIVE_SCREEN_NAMES) do
            local screen = playerGui:FindFirstChild(screenName)
            local rootFrame = screen and screen:FindFirstChild("RootFrame")
            if rootFrame and rootFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then
                rootFrame.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
    restoreDefaultTouchControls()

    if resetCharacterState then
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid? = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Jump = false
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end
    end
end

local function bindCharacter(character:Model)
    task.defer(function()
        restoreMobileControls(true)
    end)
    task.delay(0.25, function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character == character then
            restoreMobileControls(true)
        end
    end)

    local humanoid:Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            restoreMobileControls(false)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                restoreMobileControls(false)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
if LocalPlayer.Character then
    bindCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RP = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local highlight = RP.Objects.HoverHighlight
local billboard = RP.Objects.BillboardGui

local isMobile = true

local SackDebounce = false

local currentTarget = nil
local carrying = false

local range = 12
local carryDistance = 9
local maxCarryDistance = 20
local carrySmooth = .06
local throwBoost = 8
local lastVelo = Vector3.new()
local targetPos = nil
local lastTouchPosition = nil

local PC

if UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled and not UIS.MouseEnabled then
	PC = false
elseif not UIS.TouchEnabled and UIS.KeyboardEnabled and UIS.MouseEnabled then
	PC = true
end

local storeConnection

local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local mobileDebounce = false

RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dT)
	local target = nil

	local inFirstPerson = (camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and
		(camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude < 1.5)

	if inFirstPerson then
		local rayOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
		local rayDirection = camera.CFrame.LookVector * range
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

		local result = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)

		if result and result.Instance and result.Instance.Parent and result.Instance.Parent:IsA("Model") and result.Instance.Parent:FindFirstChild("Pickup") then
			target = result.Instance
		end
	else
		local mouseTarget = mouse.Target
		if mouseTarget and mouseTarget.Parent and mouseTarget.Parent:IsA("Model") and mouseTarget.Parent:FindFirstChild("Pickup") then
			target = mouseTarget
		end
	end

	if target and target.Parent and target.Parent:IsA("Model") and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Pickup") then
		if not carrying and target.Parent ~= currentTarget then
			currentTarget = target.Parent
			highlight.Parent = target.Parent
			billboard.Parent = target.Parent
			billboard.Main.ObjName.Text = target.Parent.Name
			billboard.Main.Tag.Text = target.Parent.Class.Value

			if player.Character:FindFirstChild("Sack") and currentTarget ~= "MoneyBag" and currentTarget ~= nil and not SackDebounce then
				local StoreBind = player.PlayerGui.BindsUI.Container.StoreBind
				SackDebounce = true

				print(PC)
				if PC then
					StoreBind.Visible = true
				else
					player.PlayerGui.BindsUI.MobileButtons.Store.Visible = true
					print("visible")
				end

				if storeConnection then
					storeConnection:Disconnect()
					storeConnection = nil
				end
				print(currentTarget)

				storeConnection = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(key, gameProcessed)
					if gameProcessed then return end

					player.PlayerGui.BindsUI.MobileButtons.Store.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						if not gameProcessed and not mobileDebounce then
							mobileDebounce = true
							
							RP.Remotes.StoreItem:FireServer(currentTarget)

							task.wait(0.5)
							SackDebounce = false

							if storeConnection then
								storeConnection:Disconnect()
								storeConnection = nil
							end

							task.wait(0.5)
							mobileDebounce = false
						end
					end)

					if key.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
						RP.Remotes.StoreItem:FireServer(currentTarget)

						task.wait(0.5)
						SackDebounce = false
						if storeConnection then
							storeConnection:Disconnect()
							storeConnection = nil
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	else
		if currentTarget ~= nil and not carrying then
			player.PlayerGui.BindsUI.Container.StoreBind.Visible = false
			player.PlayerGui.BindsUI.MobileButtons.Store.Visible = false
			currentTarget = nil
			highlight.Parent = nil
			billboard.Parent = nil
			SackDebounce = false
		end
	end

	if carrying and currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then
		billboard.Parent = nil

		if inFirstPerson then
			targetPos = camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * carryDistance
		else
			local screenPos
			if isMobile and lastTouchPosition then
				screenPos = lastTouchPosition
			else
				screenPos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
			end

			local ray = camera:ScreenPointToRay(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)

			targetPos = ray.Origin + ray.Direction * carryDistance
		end

		local currentCFrame = currentTarget.PrimaryPart.CFrame
		local newCFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(targetPos, targetPos + camera.CFrame.LookVector), carrySmooth)

		currentTarget:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(newCFrame)
		currentTarget.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		if (camera.CFrame.Position - currentTarget.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude > maxCarryDistance then
			DropItem(false)
		end
	end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		LeftClick()
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and carrying then
		LeftUnClick()
	end
end)

UIS.TouchStarted:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end
	if mobileDebounce then return end
	
	lastTouchPosition = input.Position
	LeftClick()
end)

UIS.TouchEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end
	if carrying then
		LeftUnClick()
	end
end)

function LeftClick()
	if currentTarget ~= nil and currentTarget.Parent then
		if currentTarget.ServerOwner.Value == false then return end

		carrying = true
		if currentTarget == nil then return end
		RP.Remotes.PickupItem:FireServer(currentTarget)
		for _, d in ipairs(currentTarget:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("Part") then
				d.CollisionGroup = "Item"
			end
		end
	end
end

function LeftUnClick()
	carrying = false
	if currentTarget then
		DropItem(true)
	end
end

function DropItem(AddForce : boolean ?)
	if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then return end

	local velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	if AddForce then
		velocity = (targetPos - currentTarget.PrimaryPart.Position) * throwBoost
	end

	RP.Remotes.DropItem:FireServer(currentTarget, velocity)
	for _, d in ipairs(currentTarget:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("Part") then
			d.CollisionGroup = "Default"
		end
	end
	carrying = false
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
		RP.Remotes.UnstoreItem:FireServer()
	end
end)
